_comment: THE CLAUDE CODE CAPTURE NERVE. UserPromptSubmit + Stop both fire hooks/afferent-post.mjs — a fail-silent (~250ms), stdout-free, secret-scrubbing bridge that POSTs to the thalamus (:4113) as a 'code' afferent. UserPromptSubmit captures HIS words (source 'claude-code'); Stop captures WHAT HE WAS TAUGHT (last_assistant_message, source 'claude-code-teaching') — so the WHOLE learning turn (question + answer) flows into the ONE working memory with zero capture tax. Relative command (CWD = project root); never blocks the session; thalamus down = silent no-op. THE FORGE PACER (30 Jul 2026): UserPromptSubmit ALSO fires `forge_session.mjs contract`, whose stdout IS injected by design — THE METHOD's 12-step order + the two anti-quiz-dump laws, re-read EVERY turn instead of once at skill-load (prose read once drowns after 40 turns; that is exactly how 8 of 12 steps went missing on the first live session). Silent unless a fresh, unclosed forge session exists; silent for headless organs (ARSENAL_ORGAN=1).
